label: The ЗПС repeal is now in force: the 0.5%/1% structural-deficit caps are gone from 1 November
text: ЗИД на ЗпС (таблед by МС on 26 October, adopted on 30 October) repealed чл. 23 and чл. 24 ЗПС — the medium-term structural-deficit objective capped at 0.5% of GDP, tolerating more than 0.5% but never above 1% of GDP where general-government debt is under 40% of GDP — which БСК and АИКБ commented on through 2 November as the constraint that had bound every medium-term forecast.
